tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ngan song sbyong ba'i thabs 'jug ngogs bde ba'ilam zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo bai ro tsa na ye/ gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*/ /ngan song sdug bsngal drung 'byin pa/ /bcom ldan thams cad rig pa la/ /gus 'dud de nyid mchod tshul bshad/ /'dir ngan song thams cad sbyong bar mdzad pa'i lha mchog kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod cing sngags bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor 'khyer bder 'god pa la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lta bu'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bcas sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur par bsams la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung mdud pa bkan nas snying gar bzhag pa g.yas skor du bskor ba rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ sarba bid maṇḍal badzra tsakra hūṃ/ lan gsum mam gcig /mdun du bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du grub par gyur par bsams/ phyag rgya de nyid kha'i drung du bzhag pa la lta bzhin du sngags de nyid brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig gam ma tha bdun brjod/ de nas gzhal yas khang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi dkar ba/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bsnams pa/ shar du ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ lhor rgyal mchog rin chen/ nub tu shākya rig dbang*/ byang du me tog cher rgyas/ shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma kī/ nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma/ shar gyi rtsibs dang po la rdo rje sems dpa'/ gnyis pa la rdo rje rgyal po/ gsum pa la rdo rje chags pa/ bzhi pa la rdo rje legs pa/ lho'i rtsibs dang po la rdo rje rin chen/ gnyis pa la rdo rje gzi brjid/ gsum pa la rdo rje rgyal mtshan/

bzhi pa rdo rje bzhad pa/ nub kyi rtsibs dang po la rdo rje chos/ gnyis pa la rdo rje rnon po/ gsum pa la rdo rje rgyu/ bzhi pa la rdo rje smra ba/ byang gi rtsibs dang po la rdo rje las/ gnyis pa la rdo rje srung ba/ gsum pa la rdo rje gnod sbyin/ bzhi pa la rdo rje khu tshur/ nang gi shar lhor sgeg mo/ lho nub tu 'phreng ba ma/ nub byang du glu ma/ byang shar du gar ma/ phyi'i shar lhor bdug pa ma/ lho nub tu me tog ma/ nub byang du mar me ma/ byang shar du dri chab ma/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrogs/ bya sgor rdo rje 'bebs pa/ lha snam nang ma la bskal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug /bar pa la nyan thos bcu drug /phyi ma la rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ sgo bzhir khro bo chen po bcu drug rnams rang rang gi rgyan cha lugs dang bcas par gyur/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba skad cig gis spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi 'phror rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur bar bsams la/ thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bā da bandha nāṃ ka ro mi/ mnyam med ma'am/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /nas/ rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pa dang*/ bde gshegs rigs lnga rgyal ba yum bzhi dang*/ /sems dpa' bcu drug sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad/ /sgo ba bzhi ste rtsa lha sum cu bdun/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces phyag 'tshal/

de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa 'am/ min yang rung ste mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra wa ra sad ka raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā/ nas/ shapta pra tītstsha'i bar dang*/ de bzhin du rū pa nas/ spar sha'i bar dang*/ tsakra ratna nas/ khaṅka ratna pra tītstsha'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyas par na rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na sogs tshigs bcad gang 'dod dang sbyar nas phul chog cing*/ maṇḍal rgyas pa'am/ sa gzhi spos kyis zhes sogs kyis phul/ de nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /nas/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por bsngo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis yan lag lhag ma rnams bya ba'am/ yang na/ dbang med bdag gis zhes pa nas/ sems can sdug bsngal yang 'os gzir las dgrol/ zhes pa'i bar kun rig cho ga nas 'byung ba ltar yang rung*/ de nas rab rdo rje bstod ring ngam/ bsdu na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun rig rnam snang dang*/ /sbyong ba'i rgyal po rgyal mchog rin chen dang*/ /shākya rig dbang me tog cher rgyas sogs/ /rigs lnga yum bzhi rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje sems sogs sems dpa' bcu drug dang*/ /sgeg mo la sogs mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad/ /lcags kyu la sogs sgo ba rnam pa bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskal pa bzang po'i sems dpa' bcu drug dang*/ /nyan thos bcu drug rang rgyal bcu gnyis po/ /sgo srung khro bo chen po bcu drug ste/ /mgron thabs drug cu'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod dam/ /yang na gsol ba 'debs zhes bsgyur yang rung*/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gus pas gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad la 'khor ba dang ngan song 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob tu gsol/ de'i rgyur gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/

zhes lan mang du gsol ba gdab cing mthar/ lha rnams kyi sku'i cha dang thugs ka nas 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ste/ rang gi snying ga la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su zhugs nas byin gyis brlabs pa gyur ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥlha rnams spyan drangs nas rang gi snying gar pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇā bi shodha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ oṃ sarba bid tra ta/ oṃ bud dha lo tsa ne hūṃ/ oṃ badzra mā kī trāṃ/ oṃ badzra paṇḍa re de hi de hi siṃddha bo dhi lo kottā ri bāṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra tā re tu ttā re tu re hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swa swa swa swā hā/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūṃ/ oṃ badzra rā rā dzaḥ oṃ badzra rā ga hoḥ oṃ badzra sā dhu dhu/ oṃ badzra ratna trāṃ/ oṃ badzra te dza rya/ oṃ badzreke tu bhri/ oṃ badzra hā si hā/ oṃ badzra dharmāḥhrīḥ oṃ badzra tī kṣa dhiḥ oṃ badzra he tu kruṃ/ oṃ badzra bha ṣa bha/ oṃ badzra karmāḥkaṃ /oṃ badzra rakṣaṃ raṃ/ oṃ badzra yakṣa kṣaṃ/ oṃ badzra sindha ṣtaṃ/ oṃ badzra lā sya hūṃ/ oṃ badzra mā le trāṃ/ oṃ badzra gīrti hrīḥ oṃ badzra nri tya āḥ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe trāṃ/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa paṃ/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍa hoḥ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ri pa ri shodhā na dharmāḥ te ga ga na sa mud ga te ma hā na ya pa ri wa re swā hā/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sarba durga ti pa ri shodha na rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te saṃ mya ka saṃ buddha ya/ tatya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi shodha ne/ shud dhe bi shud dhe/ sarba karmāḥ.ā wa ra ṇā bi sho dha ne swā hā/ rnams ci 'grub bzlas te/

yig brgya brjod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rnam snang 'khor bcas 'grub gyur nas/ nas/ 'god par shog /ces pa'i bar gyis bsngo smon bya'o/ /gzhan ngan song nas 'dren pa'i sngon du rang nyid der mi ltung ba'i thabs byed dgos pas kun rig gi cho ga rgyas pa ma lcogs na'ang tshul de ltar nyin re bzhin nyams su blangs na ngan song las thar te lha mi'i rten khyad par can 'grub par 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ /zhes pa 'di'ang shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis rang gi nyams len ltar bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i gnas brtan kun dga' chos 'byor te/ 'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan thogs par gyur cig /dge legs 'phel// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ngan song sbyong ba'i thabs 'jug ngogs bde ba'i lam zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 176--PAGE 177--PAGE 174-
